summary.text: Angela Paxton is a Republican member of the Texas Senate representing District 8, elected in November 2018. She chairs the Senate Committee on Economic Development and is vice chair of the State Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Paxton, from McKinney, was a secondary math teacher and school counselor for more than 20 years and is described as the first educator elected to the Texas Senate in over two decades.
She earned an undergraduate degree in mathematical science from Baylor University and a Master of Science in Education from the University of Houston-Clear Lake.

She is vice chair of the Religious Liberty Select Committee, serves on the Finance, Education, Higher Education, Local Government and Nominations committees, and is immediate past chair of the Senate Republican Caucus.
She has four grown children and six grandchildren and is a member of Watermark Community Church.
